result.reason: The clause adds the required annual limit, 30-day written notice, business-hours restriction, independent confidential auditor, and prohibition on systems access. However, the cost shift applies to any “discrepancy” exceeding 5%, rather than only an underpayment exceeding 5%, making it broader than the preferred position and not satisfying the fallback either. The unnecessary relocation of the cost paragraph and the combination of “at least” 30 days’ notice with an audit permitted “within” 30 days also create avoidable drafting issues, although unrelated commercial intent is generally preserved.
